title: Page 8
content_zh:
赵氏跌坐在地，狼狈不堪。

「天网恢恢，疏而不漏。」靳雪鸿神情冷厉。「你终究难逃法网。」

赵氏自知已走到末路，颓然倒下。

当晚，赵氏被押进了衙门大牢。

凌晨天未亮，衙门来了差役，说赵氏在牢里咬舌自尽。

虽说她罪有应得，但听闻此事，陆忠贤跟陆诗妍还是感到心痛难过。

而同样被押至大宇候审的陆诗媚，听闻母亲自尽的消息，当场情绪崩溃，彻底的疯了。

陆府上下因着这事，全都心情沉重。

花厅里，陆忠贤、陆诗妍及靳雪鸿正商讨着将赵氏的尸身领回安葬之事。

虽然气恨赵氏的所作所为，但毕竟共同生活了十余年，感情还是有的，再说，人死了，万事已矣，亦没什么好追究怀恨。

「等一下我便遣人去衙门你继母领回来……」陆忠贤沉沉一叹。「她虽然有邪心，但这十几年来还是有照顾你的……」

「爹，我明白。」陆诗妍点点头。「顺道把诗媚也带回来吧，她已经疯了，咱们不能让她在牢里受罪。」

「也是。」陆忠贤问道：「关于诗媚，你有何想法？」

「我就要出嫁了，诗媚也不适合再待在陆府，毕竟她曾做出那些事情，我担心大家会轻贱她……」她深深吸了一口气。「咱们替她找个地方疗养吧！」

陆忠贤赞同地道：「这样也好。」

「对了，爹……」陆诗妍又问道：「老马和碧水都是因我而无辜受害，我想给他们家里一些补偿，行吗？」

「当然行。」陆忠贤想也不想地便答应了。

「谢谢爹。」

陆忠贤看着一旁安静不插话的靳雪鸿，语带试探地问道：「贤侄，你可有什么想法？」

靳雪鸿淡淡一笑。「这儿是陆府，世叔做主便行。」

「这次多亏了你，否则诗妍就……」想到女儿差点被害死，陆忠贤又是一叹。

「不过……诗妍说她是在什么向姑娘死时醒来的，谁是向姑娘？跟这事又有什么关系？赵氏又为什么杀害那位向姑娘？」

陆诗妍面有难色地看着靳雪鸿。「雪鸿，说吗？」

「但说无妨。」靳雪鸿给她一个安抚的微笑。「世叔能明白的。」

看他们两个神神秘秘的，陆忠贤越来越疑惑。「到底是怎回事？」

陆诗妍深吸一口气，鼓起勇气道：「爹，您还记得我为什么去景安吗？」

「当然记得，你说是要去什么向氏古董店买古董……咦？那向姑娘是……」

「她叫向丽平，是向氏古董店的小姐。」她说。

陆忠贤眉心一拧。「你继母和对方也不认识，为何要杀害她？」

「其实严格说来，继母也没杀了她，因为早在母将她沉进春溪之前，她已经死了。」

陆忠贤听得一头雾水。「这是什么跟什么？」

「爹，你听我说，但你可千万别太吃惊……」陆诗妍轻轻握住父亲的手，娓娓道出事情的始末。

陆忠贤听了她昏迷这段时间的各种奇遇，惊讶得张大了嘴，一时之间都说不出话来了，过了好一会儿，他才找回自己的声音，惊奇的问道：「世上真有这种事？」

「是呀。」她恬静一笑。「要不是遇到了，女儿也很难相信。」

陆忠贤点点头，沉默了一下，若有所思，须臾，他慈详地笑道：「不过话说回来，这还真是妙不可言的缘分，你本来是要去向家的，没想到真的去了向家，还成了向家的女儿。」突地，他神情一暗，「不过，他们失去了唯一的女儿，一定很伤心吧？」

陆诗妍与靳雪鸿对视一眼，隐约察觉到他的感慨。

陆忠贤抬起眼看着女儿，「你继母死了，诗媚疯了，你也要嫁人了，为父的我能够感受到向家夫妇的失落及寂寞……」

「爹……」陆诗妍眼眶一热。

是呀，她继母走了，诗媚因为发疯也即将送往它处安养，而她又即将嫁往靳家，从此之后，她爹就一个人了，想着，她满心不舍。

「世叔，」这时，靳雪鸿开口了，「今天我一直想跟您讨论一件事儿……」

陆忠贤微顿，「贤侄请说。」

靳雪鸿轻声一叹，「陆家遭此巨变，世叔想必心情还无法平复，我跟诗妍婚期在即，恐怕世叔一时半会儿是还适应不了女儿不在身边的寂寥，所以我想，世叔不知道愿不愿意一起到景安去？」

闻言，陆诗妍也难掩惊讶和惊喜，「雪鸿，你是说」

靳雪鸿朝她温柔一笑。「你肯定舍不得让世叔一个人，所以我想把世叔接到景安一起生活。」

她感动又激动地望着他，顿时说不出话来。

「陆家在安阳的宅邸跟庄子，可以找管家暂时照应，世叔要是在景安住腻了，随时都可以回来。」靳雪鸿又道：「若是世叔习惯景安的生活，到时再想想如何处理安的产业便是。」

准女婿愿意接他同住，陆忠贤雀跃惊又喜。「贤侄，你不嫌我是个累赘吗？」

「世叔何出此言？您是我的长辈，又是诗妍的父亲，我的岳父大人，我怎会觉得您是累赘？」靳雪鸿浅笑，「您千万别担心给我添麻烦，我在景安早已购置一处宅子，前前后后共五座院落，您一定能住得非常舒心自在的。」

陆诗妍一听，差点喜极而泣。「爹，真是太好了！您就来景安同住吧！」

陆忠贤点点头，感激之情全在含着泪的眼眶之中。

真相大白，陆诗妍也已平安回魂，靳雪鸿决定立刻启程回淮城，准备迎娶她过门的事宜。

在等待靳家上门迎娶的这段时间，陆诗妍也须协助父亲处理许多事情，例如为诗媚找个可以安心疗养的地方及可靠的人照护，以及找寻合适的人选代替陆忠贤管理陆家产业。

靳雪鸿启程前一晩，他来到陆诗妍的小院。

「雪鸿，你回到淮城需要多久时间？」

「约莫五到十天吧！」他说。

「是吗？」她想了一下。「那么看准了日子，再来安阳又要多少时间？」

「这得看父亲选的日子了，但应该不会太久……」说着，靳雪鸿眼底闪过一抹黠光，笑视着她。「怎么，不想跟我分开那么久？」

她羞恼地瞪了他一眼。「才没有。」

「瞧你离情依依的样子……」看她羞红了脸，他更兴起逗她、闹她的念头。

「已经离不开我了是吗？」他伸手揽着她的肩。

陆诗妍满脸通红，羞赧地用手肘撞了他一下，「厚脸皮」。

靳雪鸿不以为意，将她紧紧的搂在臂弯里。「放心，我很快就回来接你，往后你想离开我可难了，好好把握这段没有我纠缠着的自在日子吧！」

这番话既甜蜜又热情，听得她耳朵都热了。

「说真格的……」他突然一脸认真地注视着她。「你自出生便与我订亲，这么多看来，你有没有担心过？」

「担心什么？」她傻气地望着他。

「担心自己未来要嫁的是个什么样的人呀。」他说。

「倒没想那么多，爹做主的事，我就从了，爹总不会害我吧？」

他浓眉微微一蹙。「难道你没期待或想像过我是个什么样的人？」

「我没见过，要如何想像期待？」

「你七岁那年见过我，总有一点想法吧？」靳雪鸿神情认真地凝视着她。

陆诗妍思索了一下，问道：「其实我不太记得你的样子了，在万宝斋看见你时，我也没想起你是谁呀！我当时才七岁，哪里会想

听着，他有点小小沮丧地道：「那可说不定，我就记得你……」
content_en:
Mrs. Zhao fell to the ground, embarrassed.

"The Skynet is vast, sparse and not leaking." Jin Xuehong looked cold and stern."You will never escape justice."

Knowing that she had reached the end of her life, Zhao fell down.

That night, Zhao was taken to the Yamen prison.

Before dawn in the early morning, officers from the Yamen came and said that Ms. Zhao bit her tongue and committed suicide in prison.

Although she deserved it, Lu Zhongxian and Lu Shiyan still felt heartbroken and sad when they heard about it.

Lu Shimei, who was also detained in Daewoo awaiting trial, broke down emotionally on the spot and went completely crazy when she heard the news that her mother had committed suicide.

Everyone in the Lu family felt heavy because of this incident.

In the flower hall, Lu Zhongxian, Lu Shiyan and Jin Xuehong were discussing how to take Zhao's body back for burial.

Although I resented what Zhao had done, after all, they had lived together for more than ten years, and they still had feelings. Besides, after the person died, everything was over, and there was nothing to pursue and hold grudges against.

"I will send someone to the Yamen in a moment to bring your stepmother back..." Lu Zhongxian sighed deeply."Although she has evil intentions, she has still taken care of you for more than ten years..."

"Dad, I understand." Lu Shiyan nodded."Let's bring Shimei back by the way. She's gone crazy. We can't let her suffer in prison."

"Yes." Lu Zhongxian asked, "What do you think about Shimei?"

"I'm about to get married, and Shi Mei is no longer suitable to stay in the Lu Mansion. After all, she has done those things. I'm worried that everyone will look down upon her..." She took a deep breath."Let's find a place for her to recuperate!"

Lu Zhongxian agreed: "That's fine."

"By the way, dad..." Lu Shiyan asked again: "Both Lao Ma and Bishui were innocent victims because of me. I want to give their family some compensation, okay?"

"Of course." Lu Zhongxian agreed without thinking.

"Thank you dad."

Lu Zhongxian looked at Jin Xuehong who was quiet and did not interrupt, and asked tentatively: "My nephew, do you have any ideas?"

Jin Xuehong smiled faintly."This is the Lu Mansion. Uncle Shi can make the decision."

"Thanks to you this time, otherwise Shiyan would have..." Thinking that his daughter was almost killed, Lu Zhongxian sighed again.

"But... Shiyan said she woke up when Miss Xiang died. Who is Miss Xiang? What does it have to do with this matter? Why did Zhao kill that Miss Xiang?"

Lu Shiyan looked at Jin Xuehong with embarrassment."Xuehong, tell me?"

"But it doesn't matter." Jin Xuehong gave her a reassuring smile."Uncle Shi can understand."

Seeing how mysterious the two of them were, Lu Zhongxian became more and more confused."What's going on?"

Lu Shiyan took a deep breath, mustered up her courage and said, "Dad, do you still remember why I went to Jing'an?"

"Of course I remember. You said you were going to some Xiang's antique store to buy antiques... Huh? Then Miss Xiang is..."

"Her name is Xiang Liping, she is the lady from Xiang's Antique Shop." She said.

Lu Zhongxian frowned."Your stepmother didn't know the other person either, so why did you kill her?"

"Actually, strictly speaking, the stepmother didn't kill her, because she was already dead before her mother sank her into the spring stream."

Lu Zhongxian was confused when he heard this."What is this and what?"

"Dad, listen to me, but don't be too surprised..." Lu Shiyan gently held her father's hand and told the whole story.

Lu Zhongxian listened to the various adventures she had during her coma, and was so surprised that he was speechless for a moment. After a while, he found his voice and asked in surprise: "Is there really such a thing in the world?"

"Yes." She smiled quietly."If I hadn't met him, it would be hard for my daughter to believe it."

Lu Zhongxian nodded and was silent for a moment, thoughtfully. After a moment, he smiled kindly and said, "But having said that, this is really a wonderful fate. You were originally going to Xiang's family, but you didn't expect that you actually went to Xiang's family and became Xiang's daughter." Suddenly, his expression darkened, "But they must be very sad after losing their only daughter, right?"

Lu Shiyan and Jin Xuehong looked at each other, vaguely aware of his emotion.

Lu Zhongxian raised his eyes and looked at his daughter, "Your stepmother is dead, Shimei is crazy, and you are getting married. As a father, I can feel the loss and loneliness of the Xiang family and his wife..."

"Dad..." Lu Shiyan's eyes heated up.

Yes, her stepmother was gone, Shimei was about to be sent to another place to rest because she went crazy, and she was about to marry into the Jin family. From then on, her father would be alone. Thinking about it, she was filled with reluctance.

"Uncle Shi," Jin Xuehong spoke at this time, "I have always wanted to discuss something with you today..."

Lu Zhongxian paused slightly, "My dear nephew, please tell me."

Jin Xuehong sighed softly, "Uncle Shi must not be able to calm down after this huge change happened to the Lu family. Shi Yan and I are getting married soon. I'm afraid Uncle Shi won't be able to adapt to the loneliness without my daughter around for a while, so I wonder if Uncle Shi would like to go to Jing'an together?"

Hearing this, Lu Shiyan couldn't hide her surprise and surprise, "Xuehong, you mean"

Jin Xuehong smiled tenderly at her."You must be reluctant to leave Uncle Shi alone, so I want to take Uncle Shi to live with him in Jing'an."

She looked at him moved and excited, and was speechless.

"The Lu family's mansion in Anyang and Zhuangzi can find a housekeeper to take care of them temporarily. If Uncle Shi gets tired of living in Jing'an, he can come back at any time." Jin Xuehong added, "If Uncle Shi gets used to the life in Jing'an, then we can think about how to deal with An's property."

The prospective son-in-law was willing to take him to live with him, and Lu Zhongxian was surprised and delighted."My dear nephew, don't you think I'm a burden?"

"Why did Uncle Shi say this? You are my elder, Shiyan's father, and my father-in-law. How could I think you are a burden?" Jin Xuehong smiled slightly, "Don't worry about causing trouble to me. I have already purchased a house in Jing'an, with five courtyards in total. You will definitely be able to live very comfortably."

When Lu Shiyan heard this, she almost cried with joy."Dad, this is great! Come and live with us in Jing'an!"

Lu Zhongxian nodded, his gratitude filled with tears in his eyes.

The truth came to light and Lu Shiyan had returned to her soul safely. Jin Xuehong decided to leave for Huaicheng immediately to prepare to marry her.

While waiting for the Jin family to come to marry, Lu Shiyan also had to help her father deal with many things, such as finding a place for Shimei to recuperate and reliable people to take care of her, and finding a suitable candidate to replace Lu Zhongxian to manage the Lu family's property.

The night before Jin Xuehong set off, he came to Lu Shiyan's courtyard.

"Xuehong, how long will it take for you to return to Huaicheng?"

"About five to ten days!" he said.

"Really?" She thought for a moment."Then we have determined the date. How long will it take to come to Anyang?"

"It depends on the day chosen by father, but it shouldn't be too long..." As he said that, Jin Xuehong's eyes flashed with a sly light and he looked at her with a smile."What, you don't want to be separated from me for so long?"

She glared at him in embarrassment."No."

"Look at the way you are separated from love..." Seeing her face blushing with embarrassment, he even had the idea of teasing her and making trouble with her.

"You can't live without me anymore, right?" He put his arm around her shoulders.

Lu Shiyan's face turned red and she bumped him with her elbow shyly, saying "shamelessly".

Jin Xuehong didn't take it seriously and held her tightly in his arms."Don't worry, I'll be back to pick you up soon. It will be difficult for you to leave me in the future. Make the best of this free time without my entanglement!"

The words were sweet and passionate, making her ears warm.

"Seriously..." He suddenly looked at her seriously."You have been engaged to me since birth. It seems that you have been worried at all?"

"What are you worried about?" She looked at him stupidly.

"I'm worried about what kind of person I will marry in the future," he said.

"I didn't think too much about it. I just obeyed my father's decision. He won't harm me, right?"

His thick eyebrows frowned slightly."Have you never expected or imagined what kind of person I am?"

"I've never seen it, how can I imagine the expectations?"

"You met me when you were seven years old. You must have some ideas, right?" Jin Xuehong stared at her seriously.

Lu Shiyan thought for a while and asked: "Actually, I don't remember much about you. When I saw you in Wanbaozhai, I didn't remember who you were! I was only seven years old at the time, how could I think

Listening, he said a little frustrated: "Maybe, I will remember you..."
